name: GreyNoise (Community API and Visualizer)
tier_rationale: Established company with a published EULA, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted; P148 chair rationale: 'GreyNoise is an established company: tier trusted').

reliability.justification: Classifications come from GreyNoise's own sensor network (mass-scanner noise) and its curated RIOT list of common business services; 'not observed' only means no scanning was seen by its sensors.

greynoise.description: GreyNoise API key (sent in the 'key' header of the Community API; raises the weekly lookup quota)
greynoise.plan_hint: free/community keys are non-commercial (EULA s.2.3): record 'business' only for a paid GreyNoise plan or a written GreyNoise confirmation covering internal defence (P148 cond 2)

community.title: GreyNoise Community API (GET /v3/community/{ip}: noise, riot, classification, name, last_seen)

terms.quote: GreyNoise ... offers certain non-paid subscriptions for Free Customers wishing to use GreyNoise Products for non-commercial purposes (EULA s.2.3; s.3.1: 'limited to your internal business purposes or noncommercial purposes')

community.notes: P148 cond 1-2: the free community tier is classed noncommercial; off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (a licence_allow entry for greynoise.community with scope 'internal defence, no resale or redistribution' after GreyNoise's written confirmation, or a paid plan recorded as key_plans.greynoise = business). HTTP 404 {'message': 'IP not observed scanning the internet.'} is the documented absence ('not observed scanning by GreyNoise', never 'benign'); HTTP 429 {plan, rate_limit '25-W'} is the per-egress weekly quota (could not verify).
community.licensed_alternative: A paid GreyNoise plan recorded as key_plans.greynoise = 'business', or a licence_allow entry for greynoise.community citing GreyNoise's written confirmation (internal defence only, no resale or redistribution).

x_quota_window.evidence: HTTP 429 body rate_limit '25-W' and X-Ratelimit-Limit: 25 observed 2026-11-25/26; ~50/week for a free key per the research record (C0335)
x_quota_window.interim: P334 quota blocks have no weekly window yet: greynoise_community declares Module.daily_quota = 3 (P148 cond 3) and seeds-only runs

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-3 (P148). viz.greynoise.io is the manual Visualizer page (403 to scripts from a datacenter egress on 2026-11-26: manual link only, never fetched). No P334 quota block: the published limit is weekly (see x_quota_window), the module's daily_quota is the interim budget.
